body: Confirmed P1 offline Library follow-up to ef307d8d: native actual Sony workflow returned zero declarations when requested /var/.../photos differed from indexed /private/var/.../photos. Native frozen API intentionally accepts lexical canonical catalog folder and never canonicalizes disconnected originals. EngineLibrary.scan currently opens with handle.path but stores folder: folder (caller alias); AppModel remembers caller URL. Fix online folder authority to capture/persist canonical index handle.path and carry it through recent/relaunch/reopen/rescan. Preserve friendly title if desired; do not resolve missing paths or guess symlinks offline. Add regression with online caller alias distinct from canonical catalog folder, then offline reopening must pass captured canonical folder to cached closure/native adapter and not alias. Current native test correction94557873 uses captured index_folder.path; production contract unchanged. Preserve all existing source fixes and source-only/no-build hold. Publish tests/product/handoff on same branch, A review/compiler/main.
